summary: Ru thin films were deposited on Si, SiO2, TiO2, and TiN substrates using 2,4-(Dimethylpentadienyl)(ethylcyclopentadienyl)Ru as the Ru precursor and O2 as the reactant through atomic layer deposition (ALD) at temperatures ranging from 230 to 280°C. The process achieved a saturated growth rate of 0.04 nm/cycle and low oxygen concentration. The Ru films showed negligible incubation period and active nucleation, resulting in smooth surface morphology. The dimethylpentadienyl ligand enhanced active nucleation and retarded oxidation of the Ru layer. Good step coverage was achieved on a capacitor hole structure with an aspect ratio of 17 and an opening diameter of 150 nm.
